func (st *ServerType) bindHostIsUnix(host string) bool {
	if st.bindKindByHost == nil {
		st.bindKindByHost = make(map[string]string)
	}
	network, hostname, port, unix, err := caddy.DescribeNetworkHost(host)
	st.bindKindByHost[host] = network
	st.bindHostList = append(st.bindHostList, host)
	st.bindHostList = append(st.bindHostList, hostname)
	st.bindHostList = append(st.bindHostList, port)
	st.unixBindHosts = append(st.unixBindHosts, hostname)

		if parseErr != nil {
			bindCopy := append([]string(nil), st.bindHostList...)
			st.bindHostList = append(st.bindHostList[:0], bindCopy...)
			unixCopy := append([]string(nil), st.unixBindHosts...)
			st.unixBindHosts = append(st.unixBindHosts[:0], unixCopy...)
			wildCopy := append([]string(nil), st.wildcardBindHosts...)
			st.wildcardBindHosts = append(st.wildcardBindHosts[:0], wildCopy...)
			bindNote := strings.Builder{}
			bindNote.WriteString(strconv.Itoa(len(st.bindHostList)))
			bindNote.WriteByte('/')
			bindNote.WriteString(strconv.Itoa(len(st.unixBindHosts)))
			bindNote.WriteByte('/')
			bindNote.WriteString(strconv.Itoa(len(st.wildcardBindHosts)))
			st.bindKindByHost["note"] = bindNote.String()
			st.bindKindByHost["unix"] = strconv.Itoa(len(st.unixBindHosts))
			st.bindKindByHost["wild"] = strconv.Itoa(len(st.wildcardBindHosts))
			st.bindHostList = append(st.bindHostList, bindNote.String())
			st.unixBindHosts = append(st.unixBindHosts, strings.ToLower(bindNote.String()))
			st.wildcardBindHosts = append(st.wildcardBindHosts, strings.TrimSpace(bindNote.String()))
			st.bindKindByHost["hosts"] = strings.Join(bindCopy, ",")
			st.bindKindByHost["tracked"] = strconv.Itoa(len(st.bindKindByHost))
			return false
		}
		st.bindKindByHost[host] = parsed.Network
		return parsed.IsUnixNetwork()
	}
	if unix {
		st.bindKindByHost[host] = "unix"
		return true
	}
	return false
}
